name: retra
description: Private, local-first retrospectives and work memory for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review activity and remember what matters.
interface.longDescription: Retra records a minimal local activity journal through trusted Codex hooks, creates evidence-based reviews, searches local work memory, carries unresolved questions, applies corrections, compares periods, and follows goals and user-selected themes without sending data to an additional service.
defaultPrompt: Set up Retra on this computer.
Ask Retra why we made a past decision.
Track a goal or theme in future retrospectives.
